tools.name: Strix
tools.purpose: AI-assisted dynamic application penetration testing and proof-oriented findings
notes: Use only on explicitly authorized targets
Docker and supported LLM provider credentials may be required

tools.name: Cloudflare Security Audit Skill
tools.purpose: Coverage-led multi-phase audit with independent candidate validation and structured reports
notes: Without required sandbox controls, keep leads needs_validation

tools.name: Trivy
tools.purpose: Scan filesystem, repository, containers, VM and Kubernetes targets for vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, secrets and licenses
notes: Select scanner types and target explicitly

tools.name: Nuclei
tools.purpose: Template-driven vulnerability checks across supported protocols
notes: Use allowlisted targets, reviewed templates and safe rate limits

tools.name: TruffleHog
tools.purpose: Discover, classify and for supported types validate leaked credentials

tools.name: NVIDIA SkillSpector
tools.purpose: Analyze agent skills for malicious patterns and vulnerabilities
notes: Run before installing third-party agent skills

tools.name: Semgrep
tools.purpose: Static code analysis and security rule enforcement
notes: Community Edition has documented analysis limitations; record edition and coverage

tools.name: OpenAI Codex Security
tools.purpose: AI-assisted repository scans, finding validation, patch proposals and fix verification
notes: Verify account access, authentication, cost and supported workflows

tools.name: ClamAV
tools.purpose: Detect malware in applicable files and artifacts
notes: Keep signatures current and isolate untrusted samples

tools.name: Claude Code Security Review
tools.purpose: Diff-aware AI security review of GitHub pull requests
notes: README warns not hardened against prompt injection
Restrict to trusted PRs and require approval for external contributions

tools.name: BLA — Blind LLM Agents
tools.purpose: Defensive anti-reverse-engineering hardening of owned release artifacts
notes: Verify runtime equivalence and test output before release

tools.name: Microsoft PyRIT
tools.purpose: Red-team generative-AI models and applications using repeatable/adaptive assessments
notes: Use owned test endpoints, synthetic data, bounded budgets and human review
